newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 348,700 MT were 22 percent below the previous week and 9 percent less than the 4-week average.

Major increases for Mexico (112,600 MT), Germany (82,400 MT), Israel (40,000 MT), and Spain (29,100 MT) were partially offset by reductions for France (30,100 MT). Sales of 57,400 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were mainly for unknown destinations (55,900 MT). Exports of 449,400 MT were off 53 percent from the previous week and 37 percent from the 4-week average. The primary destinations were the Netherlands (99,500 MT), Germany (82,400 MT), Japan (60,100 MT), Taiwan (38,900 MT), and Indonesia (33,000 MT).
